question.text: In an open-ended Cat III AIF scheme, investors are permitted to:

answer.text: Redeem only at the end of a fixed maturity period (typically 5-7 years)
Subscribe and redeem units at periodic intervals (e.g., monthly/quarterly/semi-annual) at NAV declared as specified in the PPM
Withdraw capital on demand with same-day settlement
Redeem only if SEBI grants specific permission for each redemption

explanation.text: The Logic: Open-ended Cat III schemes allow periodic subscriptions and redemptions at the NAV declared per the intervals specified in the PPM. The Trap: Option A describes close-ended. Option C (on-demand same-day) is not how AIF NAV-based pricing works. Option D is fabricated; SEBI does not approve each redemption. Note: The workbook (pp. 83, 125, 391) supports periodic subscriptions/redemptions at NAV per the PPM; specific settlement timelines and cut-offs are scheme-specific PPM matters, not uniform workbook rules.
